name: INOVANOC
notes:
**Inovanoc Solucoes em Suporte** - IT and network services, developer of the **Netwiz** network management system.

- IPv6: 2804:91e0::/32.
- IPv4: 177.12.132.0/24, 177.12.142.0/23 and 189.89.245.0/24 (transferred from AS28188 in Oct/2026, origin migrating to AS274672).
- Every announced prefix has an ALTDB route/route6 object and a matching RPKI ROA.
- Peering policy: https://lg.netwiz.com.br/peering-policy
- Each /40 is announced by AS274672 through its own upstream. Ten /40 blocks are designated to partner ISPs (2804:91e0:f200, f300, f400, f500, f600, f800, fa00, fb00, fc00, fd00::/40); see whois.registro.br for the responsible party and abuse contact of each block.
- Blocks used by Inovanoc: 2804:91e0::/40, 2804:91e0:100::/40, 2804:91e0:f700::/40.
- Temporary transit for AS28188 (2804:2f8:ff00::/40), included in ALTDB::AS274672:AS-CUSTOMERS.
- Looking Glass: https://lg.netwiz.com.br
- Geofeed: https://geofeed.inovanoc.com.br/geofeed.csv
